name: Scrolling Wave
description: LFO-driven chase on a linear strip — great first patch.

name: Matrix Rainbow
description: 16×8 matrix with cylindrical colour sweep and hue spin.

name: Audio Reactive
description: Blend gradient + noise; audio bands drive mix and travelling mask. Pick device or file on Audio In.

name: Timeline Sequence
description: Four-segment show driven by Timeline (16-beat loop). Beat clocks Sequence; phase scrolls the gradient. Use ] to advance manually.

name: Ring Pulse
description: Distance-field ring with LFO-pulsed strobe overlay.

name: Logic Switch Demo
description: LFO toggles between two looks using Compare + Switch.

name: Club Show (Matrix)
description: Full 4-act matrix show: Timeline-driven sequence (40-beat loop), per-act FX chains, audio intensity + strobe, vignette finish.

name: Nested Acts
description: Sequence inside a sequence: Timeline (32-beat loop) clocks both layers; loop trigger restarts Ramp; audio crossfade control.

name: Venue Install
description: Bar + ring + matrix: fixture-scoped branches mapped back with Fixture, Merge compositing, Timeline sequence, spherical base.

name: Signal Labyrinth
description: Deep float routing (delay/hold/ramp/gate/compare) driving a 5-layer pixel compositing stack on a 32×8 matrix.
